description: This file defines types, functions, and constants related to message channels, session management, queue events, and approval workflows within a chat or messaging system.

methods.name: toText
methods.description: Converts an unknown value to a trimmed string if possible.

methods.name: resolveMessageId
methods.description: Resolves a message ID from an object, checking nested __openclaw property if necessary.

methods.name: summarizeResult
methods.description: Creates a summary object with a label and count.

methods.name: resolveConversationChannel
methods.description: Determines the message channel from a session row.

methods.name: toConversation
methods.description: Converts a session row into a conversation descriptor if possible.

methods.name: matchEventFilter
methods.description: Checks if a queue event matches a given filter based on cursor and session key.

methods.name: extractAttachmentsFromMessage
methods.description: Extracts non-text attachments from a message object.

methods.name: normalizeApprovalId
methods.description: Normalizes an approval ID by trimming whitespace.
